events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: Music Television, MTV, launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' as its very first music video.

angles.name: Video Killed The Radio Star
angles.copy: Forty-five years ago today, MTV launched and changed music forever. The first video? A prophetic tune from The Buggles.

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, began on August 15, 1969.

angles.name: Remember Woodstock
angles.copy: Over half a century ago, the legendary Woodstock Festival kicked off. Three days of peace, love, and music that defined a generation.

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The music world remembers Elvis Presley, who passed away on August 16, 1977.

angles.name: Elvis' Legacy
angles.copy: Today marks 49 years since we lost The King, Elvis Presley. His music and legend live on.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the formidable frontwoman of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the legendary Liam Gallagher! Still rocking after all these years.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Licence to Thrill
angles.copy: Grab your martini, shaken not stirred! It's James Bond Day, celebrating 64 years since 007 first hit the big screen.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, the iconic singer-songwriter and co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled talent and enduring legacy of John Lennon.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary actor and comedian John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedy genius, John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true legend.
